svg.text: Nine lower CSs + four upper CSs
Each upper CS connects to its corresponding lower CS and two upper neighbors.
No direct upper-CS-to-node links. Links have separate transmit/receive wires.
Lower CS: five directions, five 4:1 MUXs
Output direction bits; input selection; connection enable (EN)
Direction code above each AND gate selects its output; only one gate can be enabled.
A bar means NOT; a dot means a junction. Input codes follow the listed order (0 at top).
Upper CS: east, south and down (CS9 shown)
Output direction bits; input selection; connection enable (EN)
Direction code above each AND gate selects its output; only one gate can be enabled.
A bar means NOT; a dot means a junction. Input codes follow the listed order (0 at top).
NW / NE / SW / SE: corner nodes. U: the corresponding upper CS.
I / O: input / output. Same-direction inputs are excluded from each MUX.
E / W / N / S: physical compass directions. D: down to the corresponding lower CS.
